component.name: Super IRCam
component.summary: Qt viewer for Qianli Super IRCam / InfiRay USB thermal cameras

description.p: Super IRCam is a from-scratch Qt 6 desktop viewer for USB thermal cameras that appear as UVC 0bda:5830. It reads raw V4L2 YUYV frames, decodes 16-bit Kelvin radiometry, and draws on-image temperatures.
